description: 충청북도_환경분야정보 물환경 하천수질측정지점 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 충청북도. 충청북도 내 하천의 수질 상태를 파악하기 위해 운영되는 하천수질측정지점을 시군, 하천명, 채취 지점 기준으로 조회할 수 있는 Open API입니다. Coverage: 충청북도. The portal files it under the publisher 충청북도. Its tags are 환경분야정보, 물환경, 하천수질측정지점, 수질검사, 환경기초. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-12-09 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
